title: 有馬記念の後に・このキングにして

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo takes first place in a spectacular victory to end the year and solidify her position as the star of her generation!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just before her winning concert begins, she receives a call from her mother. This time, King Halo is calm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She tells her mother that she'll surpass her, declaring that one day her legacy will simply become "King Halo's mother" instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo leaves her phone with me and runs off to perform the concert. After listening to both of them speak, I realize how they're both similarly awkward.
